title: opcode
summary: Benilla's opcode.rs is the numeric opcode table for everything it sends and receives. MSUI's counterpart now includes every opcode exercised by implemented systems, including the contiguous channel administration block, auto-store-bag, pet autocast, compressed movement batches, the complete force-speed, base movement relay, observer MOVE_SET/SPLINE_SET speed, granted move-mode, server-scripted sound, weather, cooldown-extra, and implemented raid/group families. Absent constants continue to track whole unimplemented families rather than scattered omissions.

openItems.text: Composite opcode-table inventory remains open and needs a fresh recount after this parity pass. Channel moderation, AUTOSTORE_BAG_ITEM and PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST are now present alongside the complete force-speed, base movement relay, observer MOVE_SET/SPLINE_SET speed, granted move-mode, server-scripted sound, weather, cooldown-extra, and implemented raid/group opcodes; several miscellaneous server-event families remain to inventory.
